574-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-2486-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2438-2577-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2438-2577-5478-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2438-2577-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6073--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3703-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3703-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

333-2281-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-7452.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5621-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1494-4153-7322.notablePrerequisites:
Big Mother Mouser has five or more +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Big Mother Mouser.
1494-4153-7322.description:
Declare Big Mother Mouser as an attacker, triggering its ability, doubling the +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving five +1/+1 counters from Big Mother Mouser to Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-4153-7322.notes: If Big Mother Mouser starts with more than five +1/+1 counters, each turn will cause Big Mother Mouser to get more counters. You can then remove more counters to place them on Sage of Hours, which can allow you to gain multiple turns at once and save mana.

891-2730-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1558-2638-4231-4365-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-4365-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

250-779-1479-2692-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2692-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2841-3534-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3534-6159.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-1315-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-4289-6753-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-4885-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

4508-5396-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-5396-6847.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, giving Weftstalker Ardent the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Trickery Charm, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

1491-2033-2445-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-2445-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-2445-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4435-4550-5256-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4435-4550-5256-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2105-3204-3480-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-3480-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2316-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
1270-2316-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating nine 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

570-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-1909-4486.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

1482-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1482-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

1856-4050-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1856-4050-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding one mana of any color.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Repeat.

719-2122-4997-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Mindless Automaton has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2122-4997-5042.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2233-3962.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2034-2233-3962.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Blightbelly Rat, adding {C}{C}.
When Blightbelly Rat dies, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Blightbelly Rat from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2204-2831-4050.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2204-2831-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding one mana of any color.
Glen Elendra Archmage dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Glen Elendra Archmage, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1391-1636-3859.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional blue or black creature.
1391-1636-3859.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by tapping Fallaji Wayfarer and a blue or black creature.
Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2706-2836-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Wheel of Fortune by paying {2}{R}, causing each player to discard their hand, and causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

174-877-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
